searchText: With all the Medalla excitement I hadn't checked my altona node for a while. It's still chugging along with 12% participation. Brave little lad. Just brought brought up the 1500 epochs since finalization milestone too. Have we seen quadratic leak kick in for any of the offline validators? We have yet to analyze this. I still have my Witti validators running
